title: The Lantern
summary: Sela's far side. Open the Lid (the Enclave's code, or break its three locks), fight down to the core, and decide: destroy it, seize it or give in. Allies by flag. If the countdown runs out, or the landing's Core falls, the Lantern fires on the colony at Touchdown: Cycle (an ending, not a retry).

fails.text: The landing's Command Core has fallen. No one is left to stop it.
